errors.text_span: with the largest slice ("chat") positioned at the top-left and the smallest slice ("instruction follow") at the top-right
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the positions of the largest and smallest slices. The largest slice, "chat", starts at the 12 o'clock position and extends clockwise, occupying parts of the top-right, bottom-right, and bottom-left quadrants, not just the top-left. The smallest slice, "instruction follow", is located in the top-left quadrant, not the top-right.
